probes.name: unique-owner
probes.source:
Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Fail
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Fail:
P="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function
Function SetProp(o As Object,k As String,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Fail
CallByName o,k,VbLet,v
SetProp="OK"
Exit Function
Fail:
SetProp="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function
Function Snap(o As Object) As String
Dim k As Variant,s As String
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Formula1","Text")
s=s & CStr(k) & "=" & P(o,CStr(k)) & ";"
Next
Snap=s
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim own As Worksheet,other As Worksheet,f As Object,g As Object,s As String
Set own=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
own.Name="Owner"
Set other=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=own)
other.Name="Foreign"
own.Activate
Set f=own.Range("A1:A5").FormatConditions.AddUniqueValues
f.DupeUnique=0
own.Activate
s="before[" & Snap(f) & "]"
s=s & "|set-DupeUnique=" & SetProp(f,"DupeUnique",1) & "[" & Snap(f) & "]"
own.Activate
s=s & "|ownerAfter[" & Snap(f) & "]"
Probe=s
End Function

Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Fail
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Fail:
P="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function
Function SetProp(o As Object,k As String,v As Variant) As String
On Error GoTo Fail
CallByName o,k,VbLet,v
SetProp="OK"
Exit Function
Fail:
SetProp="ERR:" & Err.Number
End Function
Function Snap(o As Object) As String
Dim k As Variant,s As String
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Formula1","Text")
s=s & CStr(k) & "=" & P(o,CStr(k)) & ";"
Next
Snap=s
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim own As Worksheet,other As Worksheet,f As Object,g As Object,s As String
Set own=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets(1)
own.Name="Owner"
Set other=ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets.Add(After:=own)
other.Name="Foreign"
own.Activate
Set f=own.Range("A1:A5").FormatConditions.AddUniqueValues
f.DupeUnique=0
other.Activate
Set g=other.Range("A1:A5").FormatConditions.AddAboveAverage

other.Activate
s="before[" & Snap(f) & "]"
s=s & "|set-DupeUnique=" & SetProp(f,"DupeUnique",1) & "[" & Snap(f) & "]"
own.Activate
s=s & "|ownerAfter[" & Snap(f) & "]"
other.Activate
s=s & "|foreignOwnAfter[" & Snap(g) & "]"
Probe=s
End Function
